children: Ventive Hospitality Limited has appointed Percy P. Muncherji as Head – Design & Development, as the company continues to expand its hospitality portfolio in India and international markets.

In his new role, Muncherji will lead design and development across Ventive Hospitality’s portfolio, overseeing new developments, renovations and existing assets. His mandate includes design direction, development strategy, technical oversight, engagement with brands and operators, consultant leadership and project delivery.

Muncherji brings more than three decades of experience across design, development and delivery. Before joining Ventive Hospitality, he served as Vice President – Design & Technical Services at Centara Hotels & Resorts, where he led the Group’s Design and Technical Services function across multiple brands and international markets.

Earlier, he spent more than 16 years with Oakwood Asia Pacific in Singapore, ultimately serving as Vice President – Technical Services. During his tenure, he contributed to the development and delivery of 36 properties comprising approximately 5,200 units and held Board positions across Oakwood entities in Japan, China and Indonesia. He also held a senior role with The Ascott Limited, working across project design and development, technical services and property delivery in Asia.

Atul Chordia, Chairman and Executive Director, Ventive Hospitality Limited, said, “As Ventive Hospitality continues to expand and evolve its portfolio, design and development will play an increasingly important role in creating distinctive, high-quality hospitality assets. Percy brings extensive industry experience and a strong international perspective, and we look forward to his contribution in shaping the next phase of Ventive’s growth.”

Ranjit Batra, CEO, Ventive Hospitality Ltd, added, “Percy brings a distinctive combination of design leadership, development expertise and an understanding of hospitality from both an owner and operator perspective. His ability to connect design vision with brand, operational and commercial considerations will be particularly valuable as we continue to grow and enhance our portfolio.”
